headline: Infinity Trust Mortgage Bank 9M Pre-Tax Profit Increases 27% to N2.76B
summary: Infinity Trust Mortgage Bank posted a 26.94% increase in pre-tax profit to N2.76 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, up from N2.18 billion in the prior period.
why: Mortgage banking institutions in Nigeria are expanding lending portfolios despite monetary tightening and high benchmark rates across the banking sector.

impacts.name: Infinity Trust Mortgage Bank
impacts.why: Double-digit earnings growth supports balance sheet strength and capital adequacy metrics.
